notices.title: Cheque Bounce Demand Notice u/s 138 NI Act
notices.authorityName: Adv. M. Vishwanath & Associates (for Deccan Freight & Packaging Pvt. Ltd.)

authenticity.summary: Looks genuine — legal notice sent by a registered lawyer by post, asking payment only to your supplier’s company bank account.
authenticity.dinCheckNote: No government DIN needed (private lawyer notice under Cheque Bounce law; Lawyer registration KAR/1942/2014 is given).
authenticity.domainCheckNote: Matches a real law office rather than someone pretending to be a tax officer.
authenticity.paymentCheckNote: Safe: Asks you to pay only to "Deccan Freight & Packaging Pvt. Ltd." business bank account, not any personal UPI.

notices.lawSection: Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
notices.lawPlainExplanation: If a business cheque bounces due to low bank balance, you must pay that cheque amount within 15 days of getting this letter to stop a court case.
whatIsAskedLines: Cheque No. 482910 for ₹25,000 given to Deccan Freight & Packaging bounced due to low bank balance.
Pay ₹25,000 within 15 days of receiving this letter to stop a criminal court complaint.
Take a written payment receipt and collect your old cheque back after paying.
notices.amountBreakdown: Cheque Amount: ₹25,000 (Lawyer also mentions ₹3,500 notice fee; paying the ₹25,000 cheque amount within 15 days stops a Section 138 court case).
notices.severityReason: Strict 15-day time limit from receipt — missing it allows the supplier to file a court case.
notices.deadlineCalculationBasis: 15 calendar days from the day you received the notice (received 15 Oct 2026 + 15 days = 30 Oct 2026).

ignoreTimeline.title: Supplier Can File a Court Case
ignoreTimeline.detail: After 30 Oct, the supplier gets 30 days to file a cheque bounce case in the Magistrate Court.

ignoreTimeline.title: Court Summons & 20% Deposit
ignoreTimeline.detail: You will have to appear in court in person, and the court can order an immediate 20% deposit.

ignoreTimeline.title: Heavy Fine up to Double the Cheque
ignoreTimeline.detail: Fine can go up to double the cheque amount (₹50,000) along with legal trouble.

documentsChecklist.label: Postal envelope with India Post delivery date stamp
documentsChecklist.detail: Shows the exact date you received this letter (starts the 15-day count).

documentsChecklist.label: Bank cheque bounce slip & October bank statement
documentsChecklist.detail: Check the exact date and reason the cheque returned.

documentsChecklist.label: Deccan Freight bills and delivery slips
documentsChecklist.detail: Confirm that ₹25,000 is truly owed for goods received.

documentsChecklist.label: Bank transfer (NEFT/RTGS) receipt after paying
documentsChecklist.detail: Write Cheque No. 482910 in the bank transfer remark.

reasons: Cheque bounce notices can lead to a court case, so a lawyer makes sure your reply and payment receipt protect you completely.
If goods were damaged or the cheque was only given for security, a lawyer must send a written reply within 15 days.
A CA handles tax returns, whereas a lawyer handles Section 138 cheque bounce replies.

notices.title: GST Show-Cause Notice (Form GST DRC-01)
notices.authorityName: Assistant Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (GST Office LGSTO-020), Bengaluru

authenticity.summary: Looks genuine — has an official government DIN number, comes from @gst.gov.in, and asks payment only on the official GST website.
authenticity.dinCheckNote: Official DIN CBIC-2026-10-4918273645 is printed clearly (can be checked on esanchar.cbic.gov.in).
authenticity.paymentCheckNote: Safe: Asks payment only on services.gst.gov.in — does NOT ask for any personal bank account or UPI.

notices.lawSection: Section 73(1) of the CGST / KGST Act, 2017 (Form GST DRC-01)
notices.lawPlainExplanation: The GST officer is asking you to explain a mismatch between the GST credit you claimed and what your suppliers uploaded.
whatIsAskedLines: Your GST return claimed ₹15,200 more input tax credit than what showed up from your suppliers.
Upload your purchase bills, transport slips, and bank payment proof on the GST portal to explain.
Or, if the claim was a mistake, pay ₹18,500 (₹15,200 tax + ₹1,800 interest + ₹1,500 fine) within 30 days.
notices.severityReason: You have 30 days to reply — if you upload supplier bills on time, you may not have to pay this money.
notices.deadlineCalculationBasis: 30 calendar days from the day you received the GST notice (received 6 Oct 2026 + 30 days = 5 Nov 2026).

ignoreTimeline.title: One-Sided Final Tax Bill (DRC-07)
ignoreTimeline.detail: If you do not reply, the GST officer can make the ₹18,500 bill final without hearing your side.

ignoreTimeline.title: 18% Yearly Interest Keeps Growing
ignoreTimeline.detail: Daily interest keeps adding onto ₹15,200 until resolved.

ignoreTimeline.title: E-Way Bill Block & Bank Hold
ignoreTimeline.detail: GST portal can stop your e-Way bills for shop goods and recover money from your bank account.

documentsChecklist.label: List matching your GSTR-3B return with supplier GSTR-2B

documentsChecklist.label: Original GST purchase bills from those suppliers
documentsChecklist.detail: Must clearly show GST number and tax breakup.

documentsChecklist.label: E-Way bills and transport lorry receipts
documentsChecklist.detail: Proves the spice sacks actually came to your shop.

documentsChecklist.label: Bank statement showing NEFT payment to those suppliers
documentsChecklist.detail: Proves you paid the supplier along with GST.

reasons: If your CA Ramesh already files your monthly GST, share this notice with him so he can upload Form DRC-06 cleanly.
If a supplier filed late in the next month, attaching the bills and bank proof usually closes the matter.
You do not need a court lawyer for this GST portal notice.

notices.title: Income Tax Intimation u/s 143(1)

authenticity.summary: Looks genuine — routine computer check from CPC Bengaluru with an official reference number and @cpc.incometax.gov.in email.
authenticity.dinCheckNote: Official CPC Reference CPC/2627/A6/2491827345 can be seen after logging in to eportal.incometax.gov.in.
authenticity.domainCheckNote: Official Income Tax Department (.gov.in) email address.
authenticity.paymentCheckNote: Safe: Any payment is only on the official Income Tax portal (e-Pay Tax), never to any private account.

notices.lawPlainExplanation: This is an automatic computer check comparing your filed Income Tax Return with tax credit records on the portal.
whatIsAskedLines: The Income Tax computer found ₹6,400 less TDS tax credit in your Form 26AS than what was written in your return.
Check if your wholesale buyer has now updated their TDS filing in Form 26AS.
Log in to the Income Tax portal to ask for a free computer re-check, or pay ₹6,400 if it was claimed by mistake.
notices.severityReason: Routine computer summary — not a raid or audit, and you still have 25 days to respond online.
notices.deadlineCalculationBasis: 30 calendar days from receiving the intimation email (received 19 Oct 2026 + 30 days = 18 Nov 2026).

ignoreTimeline.title: 1% Monthly Interest Starts
ignoreTimeline.detail: Simple interest of 1% per month (~₹64/month) starts adding onto ₹6,400.

ignoreTimeline.title: Future Tax Refund Adjusted
ignoreTimeline.detail: If you get any tax refund next year, ₹6,400 will be cut from it.

ignoreTimeline.title: Tax Officer Reminder
ignoreTimeline.detail: You will get a reminder email to clear or reply to the pending ₹6,400 demand.

documentsChecklist.label: Latest Form 26AS and AIS tax credit statement
documentsChecklist.detail: Check if the ₹6,150 TDS from your customer now shows up.

documentsChecklist.label: Form 16A TDS certificate given by your customer
documentsChecklist.detail: Check customer TAN number and amount deducted.

documentsChecklist.label: Copy of filed Income Tax Return for this year
documentsChecklist.detail: Check that there was no typing mistake in the TDS entry.

advisorGuidance.roleLabel: Online Portal (or ask your CA during regular visit)
reasons: For a small ₹6,400 TDS computer mismatch, clicking "Tax Credit Mismatch" online takes 5 minutes with zero fee.
If TDS was typed twice by mistake, you can pay ₹6,400 directly on the portal.
You can also forward it on WhatsApp to CA Ramesh if he keeps your portal password.
